question: Which of the following bodies is NOT mentioned in the constitution?
solution:
The correct answer is the __**National Human Rights Commission**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/64e177b3c5c5cb81c12b3d5b5ddabaaf474cdad3d6098992ca6592786c8147d6.png] 

 
• **Constitutional Bodies:**

 
 
• These are the bodies that are mentioned in the constitution of India and so considered as independent and more powerful.
 
• **Constitutional Bodies in India**
 
 
• Election Commission
 
• Attorney General of India
 
• Comptroller and Auditor General (CAG)
 
• Finance Commission
 
• National Commission for Scheduled Castes
 
• National Commission for Scheduled Tribes
 
• Special officer for Linguistic Minorities
 
• Union Public Service Commission
 
• State Public Service Commission
